wiki's leveling3 max values (36*5..72*5=180..360, +150% AP) disagree with bin NunuW#MaximumSnowballDamage which states BaseDamage=[180/225/270/315/360] + 1.5xAP (150% AP matches, but base disagrees: wiki computes 36*5 to 72*5 = 180 to 360 using a linear-in-rank formula 36+9*rank*5 rather than the bin's actual per-rank values [180,225,270,315,360]); recording wiki's stated numbers as required.
0.333 scalar matches NunuW.NoImpactDamageScalar; applied to the same 'minimum' base-per-rank values used in w_1 (36..72 scaled by rank), not directly a bin row.

mechanics.claim: Willump becomes slow-immune and ghosted while channeling, and cleanses himself of all slows on cast.
mechanics.quote: '''Willump''' {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} himself from all {{tip|slow|slows}} and {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to 10 seconds, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and {{tip|slow-immune}}

mechanics.claim: The snowball explodes on hitting an enemy champion (or large monster/terrain), dealing AoE magic damage that scales up with charge time, and applies knockup then stun scaling with charge time.
mechanics.quote: The snowball explodes upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}}, {{tip|pet|large pet}}, medium or large {{tip|monster}}, or terrain, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies

mechanics.claim: Against minions and small monsters, the snowball instead rolls over them dealing only 33.3% of the damage, without exploding.
mechanics.quote: The snowball rolls over enemy {{tip|minion|minions}} and small monsters hit, dealing {{fd|33.3}}% of the damage as {{as|magic damage}}.

mechanics.claim: The snowball can be recast to manually release it early, or it auto-releases after the max channel duration or on interruption.
mechanics.quote: ''Biggest Snowball Ever!'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds during the channel, and does so automatically after the channel or if {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown starts only after the effect (channel/release) ends, not on initial cast.
The initial cast and the manual recast each count as separate ability activations for on-cast effects.
mechanics.quote: The initial cast and the manual recast count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}}
